blocks.text: Park Jihyo of Twice has announced her departure from JYP Entertainment after 21 years with the agency, becoming the third member of the K-pop girl group to leave the company. Park shared the news in a handwritten letter posted on Instagram on Wednesday, Oct. 21. She also revealed that she has established her own company, EMITHAUS, as she begins a new chapter in her career. “After 21 years, my journey with JYP Entertainment, which began when I was just a child, has come to an end,” she wrote. “From my childhood to my adolescence to becoming an adult, I spent most […]...
